Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while making a left turn. Symptoms reported at
the first visit included neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with a whiplash-type mechanism, and the injury pattern
described is plausible for a crash of this kind. Examination findings and imaging clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical
region. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain in the same area, which resolved completely without lasting limitation
and does not account for the current presentation. Treatment followed a typical course of conservative care, including manual
therapy and a home exercise program. Symptoms improved steadily across the two visits, and care was tapered accordingly.
Billed services reflect the visits actually rendered, with no repeated charges for the same service. Prognosis is good with
continued self-directed exercise and return to normal activity as tolerated.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
